recommended_primary: Unexplained hypoglycemia (possible medication‑induced, adrenal insufficiency, hepatic dysfunction, or lab error)
review_summary: The junior differential captures the major chronic disease clusters and flags two red‑flag labs, but it under‑weights conditions that are definitively present (OSA, substance‑use) and fails to provide any plausible etiology for the severe low fasting glucose. Probabilities have been re‑balanced to reflect the strength of evidence, and critical gaps (BP data, eGFR, endocrine work‑up) are highlighted. Prioritizing the hypoglycemia work‑up and reinforcing OSA and substance‑use management will improve diagnostic accuracy and patient safety.
